```yaml
name: Coffee Bot Lottery Poster

# Run every day at 09:00 Beijing time (UTC+8 → 01:00 UTC)
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 1 * * *'  # 01:00 UTC = 09:00 Beijing

jobs:
  post-coffee-lottery:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      # The bot token must have `create_post` permission (set in the repository secrets)
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Build coffee bot
        run: |
          # Compile the CoffeeBot Java class (assumes src/main/java/CoffeeBot.java exists)
          mkdir -p target
          javac -d target src/main/java/CoffeeBot.java

      - name: Run coffee bot
        env:
          COFFEE_BOT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.COFFEE_BOT_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # Execute the CoffeeBot which posts the daily lottery thread
          java -cp target CoffeeBot
```
